workflows.title: Literature & evidence
workflows.description: Review publications, trials and source disagreements with attributable references.
requirements: Verified publication identifiers and copyright/AI-use permissions
Article-level provenance, retraction and freshness checks

workflows.title: Data analysis & code
workflows.description: Plan reproducible analysis of approved structured research datasets and computational notebooks.
requirements: Reproducible code, parameters and validation outputs

workflows.title: Scientific modelling
workflows.description: Scope computational chemistry, molecular and biological models for qualified research teams.
requirements: Validated model applicability and scientific boundary

workflows.title: Research tool connections
workflows.description: Map scientific databases, literature identifiers and reference managers to governed adapters.
requirements: Individually verified upstream APIs and permitted reuse
No mobile API keys; immutable intake and revocation

workflows.title: Hypotheses & experiments
workflows.description: Track testable research questions, disconfirming evidence and human-reviewed experiment proposals.
requirements: Qualified human approval of experiment design
Controlled lab execution and independent replication

workflows.title: Research operations
workflows.description: Prepare draft study briefs, grant outlines, manuscript plans and evidence-led research reporting.
requirements: Human editorial, regulatory and release approval

releaseGates: Verified private Cognito/MFA session and tenant
Approved pharmaceutical scientific data and AI-use rights
Research model/API eligibility and account approval where applicable
Bounded server-side execution with audit and budget ceilings
iOS and Android device, privacy, accessibility and signing verification
Restricted GPT-Rosalind models are internal-only: never enable customer-facing or external commercial API use
